title: Fantastic UI. Horrible bugs.
body: My wife and I bought this app to help plan meals for our infant. There are critical logic bugs that need to be fixed. For example, if you switch units from metric to imperial, and add new items to your shopping list, the list has items in grams and in cups. The app should standardize the list in one set of units. My wife added one recipe and the app bombed on her. She restarted and went to her shopping list. Apparently we need to purchase 110 onions this week for one of the recipes. Not sure I could eat that many onions let alone our baby. Two examples of many bugs that are prevalent in this version of the app. Obvious no one tested this before releasing to the App Store.
